name: United Arab Emirates
sources: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships (private sector, not domestic workers)

rules.match_hint: employer, agent or company keeps, holds or stores the worker's passport, Emirates ID or other official documents
rules.why: Your employer is not allowed to hold your passport or other official documents.
rules.action: Do not hand over your passport. If it was taken, report it to MOHRE on 600 590000.

rules.match_hint: worker pays, or has deducted from salary, recruitment fees, visa costs, placement or service charges, or must repay recruitment costs
rules.why: Employers may not charge you recruitment or employment fees, directly or indirectly (for example through salary deductions).
rules.action: Do not pay. Keep proof of anything you already paid and report it to MOHRE.

rules.match_hint: deductions from salary for housing, food, fines, loans, damages, or any deduction not listed by law
rules.why: Deductions are only allowed in cases listed by law: loans need your written consent and no interest, fines are capped at 5% of the wage, and all deductions together cannot exceed 50%.
rules.action: Ask what each deduction is for, in writing. Keep your payslips.

rules.match_hint: worker pays for accommodation provided by employer, housing cost deducted from wage
rules.why: The employer must provide proper licensed accommodation, or pay a housing allowance or include it in the wage.
rules.action: Ask whether housing is free or included in your wage, and get it in writing.

rules.match_hint: more than 8 hours a day or 48 hours a week, or hours left open 'as per company requirement'
rules.why: Normal working time is capped at 8 hours a day or 48 a week. Overtime is limited to 2 hours a day, and total hours cannot pass 144 in 3 weeks.
rules.action: Ask for your working hours to be written in the contract. Keep a daily record.

rules.match_hint: overtime unpaid, included in salary, or paid at the normal rate
rules.why: Overtime must be paid at your basic hourly wage plus at least 25%, or plus 50% for hours between 10 pm and 4 am (except shift workers).
rules.action: Ask for the overtime rate in writing. Keep a daily record of your hours.

rules.match_hint: work 7 days a week, no weekly day off
rules.why: You are entitled to at least one paid day off every week.
rules.action: Ask for a fixed weekly day off in the contract.

rules.match_hint: less than 30 days annual leave per year, or no annual leave
rules.why: You get at least 30 days of paid annual leave per year (2 days per month in your first year after 6 months).
rules.action: Ask for the leave clause to match the law.

rules.match_hint: worker must pay a fine, penalty, recruitment costs or compensation for resigning or leaving early
rules.why: If you resign, the law only requires you to give 30 to 90 days' written notice. If you skip the notice, the compensation is your wage for the missing notice days. Recruitment costs can never be charged to you, and threatening penalties to make you work is forbidden.
rules.action: Ask for this clause to be removed or limited to the notice period. Report threats to MOHRE.

rules.match_hint: final contract will be given on arrival, no written contract, terms may change later
rules.why: Your employer must sign a written contract with you on the official Ministry form and give you a copy. Contracts that only appear after you arrive are a common way to change the promised salary or job.
rules.action: Ask to see the MOHRE contract or offer before you travel or pay anything.

rules.match_hint: employer may assign any other job, task or location as needed
rules.why: You cannot be made to do work fundamentally different from your contract without your written consent. If it happens, you may leave without notice and keep your end-of-service rights.
rules.action: Make sure your job title and duties are written clearly.

rules.match_hint: worker pays for their own ticket home
rules.why: The employer pays your trip home when the job ends, unless you have already moved to another employer or the contract ended because of your fault.
rules.action: Ask for the employer-paid return ticket to be written in the contract.
